description: The structured window of recent outreach leads (activity in the ~30 days before the latest report): per lead, the conversation summary, last message (who/when/text), LinkedIn profile link, owning salesperson, and current status. Requires the outreach section in scope; an own-leads-only key sees only its own leads, while an unrestricted key sees every salesperson's, each row carrying its owner slug.
name: get_recent_leads
